hints.title: Inverted Depth Cumulative Aggregation
hints.text: Integers located at shallow depths need higher multipliers than integers located deeper down, with leaf-most elements weighted by one.

hints.title: Cumulative Level Prefix Summation
hints.text: Instead of finding maximum depth first, iterate through levels. Accumulate the sum of integers encountered so far; at each level transition, add this running unweighted total to the answer.

hints.title: Single-Pass BFS Blueprint
hints.text: Initialize unweighted = 0 and weighted = 0. While current level list is non-empty: iterate items; add integers to unweighted; collect sublists into next_level. Add unweighted to weighted. Repeat with curr_level = next_level.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: total elements across all nested levels
complexity.notes: Single pass BFS accumulates weights without a preliminary depth-measuring pass.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: A two-pass approach that computes maxDepth then recurses incurs redundant traversals and extra overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Level array holds at most one horizontal breadth layer at a time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Accumulating unweighted sums across BFS steps to avoid a separate maximum depth pass.
